title: indigo_mount_synscan: GoTo, finalizer and abort ALERT exits bypass indigo_update_coordinates()
description: Some ALERT exits of the GoTo handler, its finalizer and MOUNT_ABORT_MOTION publish MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES directly instead of through indigo_update_coordinates(), so the kept-ALERT state of the mount base class does not see them. Also consider the hardening noted in review: the poll should keep BUSY for sync_pending only while the property is already BUSY, and the slew branch should clear sync_pending. Found while working on ticket 42b85be0-1f19-4607-b3c3-746e60317d17 (closed, commit a09e0f878), which introduced the kept coordinates ALERT in indigo_update_coordinates(): an ALERT published after a BUSY stays until the next BUSY. Reproduce in the driver's simulator suite before changing code.
